target_qwen35.notes: Exact target used for the archived 35B runs. The file is not in this repository and was absent from the source machine on 2026-11-05.

draft_dflash2.notes: GGUF draft is missing; the source machine retains the BF16 safetensors and config only.

draft_dflash1.notes: Older DFlash draft used by dflash-rocm.log; block_size=16, not DFlash2. The log reports 736.12 MiB; exact bytes were not recorded.

mtp_qwen35.notes: MTP-capable target used by the 2026-10-18 speculative comparison. SHA256 was not recorded.

lfm_iq4_nl.notes: Present on the source machine; useful for a short harness smoke test.

binaries.notes: The Vulkan and ROCm llama-server hashes match the archived 2026-10-02 hash file exactly. The archived llama-bench binary hash was not recorded.

roofline.notes: Active parameter count is the vendor 'A3B' label, not an independently measured activation count. The model is hybrid: 10 full-attention layers (full_attention_interval=4) use F16 K/V with 2 KV heads and head_dim 256, giving 2 * 2 * 256 * 2 * 10 = 20,480 bytes/token. The 30 SSM/recurrent layers use a 1,067.81 MiB state; its per-token traffic is not modeled. Peak assumes LPDDR5X-7500, 128-bit; exact RAM speed was not recorded.
